title: Learning Disentangled Textual Representations via Statistical Measures of Similarity

bias_targets.methodology: Training an adversarial probing classifier to predict the sensitive attribute (author's race: non-Hispanic blacks vs. non-Hispanic whites) from the latent textual representations of the DIAL corpus to measure the degree of disentanglement.
Training an adversarial probing classifier to predict the sensitive attribute (author's age group: above 35 vs. below 35) from the latent textual representations of the PAN corpus.
Training an adversarial probing classifier to predict the sensitive attribute (author's gender) from the latent textual representations of the PAN corpus.
